instruction: Navigate to the Teams page on nba.com to see all NBA teams.

metadata.trajectory_summary: Agent started on nba.com and attempted to browse women's Nike jerseys. Clicked Store link which redirected to global.nbastore.com, received HTTP 403 (Access Denied). Spent all 50 turns trying alternative store URLs and Google search, all blocked by network restrictions.
metadata.capability_extraction: Can navigate nba.com homepage, use top navigation bar (Games, Schedule, Teams, Stats, etc.), open/manage multiple Chrome tabs, type URLs in address bar, scroll pages
metadata.failure_analysis: Model failed because external store sites (global.nbastore.com, shop.nba.com) returned 403 Access Denied due to VM network restrictions. Google search also failed with SSL certificate error.
metadata.task_rationale: Simplified to navigation within nba.com. The Teams link is visible in the top navigation bar which the model successfully interacted with during the trajectory.
metadata.explanation: Task requires navigating to the NBA Teams page. Evaluator checks the active tab URL matches the teams page pattern using regex.

llm_judge_reasons: Getter 'active_url_from_accessTree' correctly extracts the active tab URL as a string, which is the right state for verifying navigation.
Metric 'is_expected_url_pattern_match' correctly receives the rules dict (with 'expected' key) and iterates over regex patterns to match against the URL.
Regex pattern 'https://.*nba\.com/teams' correctly matches the NBA Teams page URL (e.g., https://www.nba.com/teams).
Single-step navigation task is fully covered by a single URL pattern check — complete coverage.
Data flow is correct: getter returns string URL → metric handles string input → regex comparison returns 1.0 or 0.0.
